argument_bug_fix: ExportSensorDiff.java parses each script arg separately with Long.parseLong(args[n],16). Joining 80 addresses into one string yields NumberFormatException. Use a shell/Python array with one element per target.
command_template: export JAVA_HOME="..."; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"; "$HEADLESS" "$GHIDRA_PROJECT_DIR" NonUsbSensor -process firmware-sensor-g0.bbin -readOnly -noanalysis -scriptPath "$SCRIPT_DIR" -postScript ExportSensorDiff.java "$OUT_DIR" <one argv per target>

ghidra_independent_path.statement: All published claims can be re-verified from the retained pass1..pass4 exports plus the frozen BBIN and the sixth-round CONFIG_SNAPSHOT.json. The Ghidra project is only needed to regenerate the exports.

passes.name: pass1_all_80_callbacks
passes.note: 80 even-aligned callback entry points, derived by clearing bit0 of the 80 unique thumb_function_pointer values in CONFIG_SNAPSHOT.json. The first attempt passed all 80 addresses as ONE shell argument and failed at ExportSensorDiff.java line 47 with NumberFormatException; the fix is one argv element per target.

passes.name: pass2_dispatcher_and_identifier_references
passes.note: Main dispatcher, the 0x200014d8 literal slots and the USART function.

passes.name: pass3_identifier_readers_and_report_ranges
passes.note: 5 identifier reference sites plus decoded ranges covering the 3-byte identifier generation and the report object writes.

passes.name: pass4_shared_callees_and_clock_chain
passes.note: Shared callees of the short thunks: GPIO id accessors, descriptor consumers, clock writers and memcpy/memset helpers.

purpose: Exact read-only Ghidra invocations retained for this evidence folder, plus the Ghidra-independent verification path.

safety_flags.no_execution: no firmware executed; no device/account/API/network access
safety_flags.noanalysis: no auto-analysis; only already-decoded instruction rows are exported
safety_flags.range_targets: a start:end target dumps only already-decoded instructions; it never disassembles or mutates
safety_flags.readOnly: opens the existing project read-only; nothing is written back
safety_flags.script_sha_gate: ExportSensorDiff.java refuses to run unless the program SHA256 equals 51531576...a891

toolchain.java_home_required: Without exporting JAVA_HOME, analyzeHeadless aborts with "Unable to locate a Java Runtime" / "no TTY detected".
